k_justification: K=75 is primary because it is the c_v coherence PEAK (outcome-independent). The smallest-K-within-1SE rule would instead select K=30; results are reported at both. K=75 is NOT justified by its ideology R2 -- that would be circular.

k_justification_detail.explicitly_not_justified_by: ideology R2 -- selecting K on the outcome then reporting that outcome at the selected K is circular

method.transform: CLR (Aitchison 1982) applied BEFORE PCA; required because topic proportions are compositional
method.dimensionality: Horn's parallel analysis, column permutation, 95th percentile, contiguous retention from the top
method.null_ordering: permute raw proportion columns, THEN CLR (mirrors nlp/embed_rank.py's permute-then-transform)
method.pc_space: fit once on all 204 shows; targets restrict rows, not basis
method.scope: dimensionality of THIS topic representation (downstream of K and preprocessing), not of political discourse as such

embedding_arm_reference.note: cited from record for comparison; same Horn's rule and percentile as nlp/embed_rank.py
